subtopics.label: Cardiac Surgery Outcomes and Techniques
subtopics.description: Research on surgical outcomes, operative techniques, and perioperative management in cardiac surgery including coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG), aortic valve replacement, mitral valve repair, aortic root and arch surgery, and postoperative complications such as atrial fibrillation, sternal wound infections, and graft patency.
subtopics.short_description: Operative techniques and perioperative outcomes in CABG, valve replacement, and aortic surgery.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive and Open Spine Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical techniques, outcomes, and technology for spinal disorders including minimally invasive approaches (MIS-TLIF, LLIF, endoscopic), cervical and lumbar procedures, spinal deformity correction, image guidance, robotics, and augmented reality in spine surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical techniques, robotics, and image guidance for cervical, lumbar, and spinal deformity procedures.

subtopics.label: Vascular and Aortic Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on endovascular and open surgical management of aortic aneurysms, aortic dissection, peripheral arterial disease, thoracic endovascular aortic repair (TEVAR), abdominal aortic aneurysm repair (EVAR/OAR), and outcomes of vascular interventions including limb revascularization and carotid procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Endovascular and open repair of aortic aneurysms, dissection, and peripheral arterial disease.

subtopics.label: Thoracic Surgery and Lung Resection
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of lung cancer and thoracic malignancies including lobectomy, segmentectomy, wedge resection, esophagectomy, thymectomy, neoadjuvant therapy, and perioperative outcomes in thoracic surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of lung cancer and thoracic malignancies including lobectomy, esophagectomy, and thymectomy.

subtopics.label: Bariatric and Metabolic Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and endoscopic interventions for obesity including Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, sleeve gastrectomy, endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty, duodenal switch, and outcomes related to weight loss, metabolic comorbidities, and postoperative management.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical and endoscopic interventions for obesity, weight loss outcomes, and metabolic comorbidity management.

subtopics.label: Breast Surgery and Reconstruction
subtopics.description: Research on mastectomy, breast reconstruction techniques (implant-based, DIEP flap, autologous), nipple reconstruction, sensory outcomes, capsular contracture, implant safety, and oncologic outcomes in breast cancer surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Mastectomy, implant-based and autologous reconstruction techniques, and oncologic outcomes in breast surgery.

subtopics.label: Cranial and Skull Base Neurosurgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of brain tumors, skull base lesions, Chiari malformation, colloid cysts, craniosynostosis, and neurovascular conditions including operative techniques, approaches, and postoperative outcomes in cranial neurosurgery.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of brain tumors, skull base lesions, and neurovascular conditions with operative outcome analysis.

subtopics.label: Postoperative Pain Management and Opioid Prescribing
subtopics.description: Research on postoperative opioid prescribing patterns, persistent opioid use, non-opioid analgesic strategies, multimodal analgesia, and the impact of prescribing policies and regulations on surgical patients.
subtopics.short_description: Opioid prescribing patterns, persistent use, and multimodal analgesia strategies in surgical patients.

subtopics.label: Colorectal and Gastrointestinal Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of colorectal cancer, inflammatory bowel disease, small bowel obstruction, appendicitis, hernia repair, and endoscopic interventions including outcomes of minimally invasive colorectal procedures and enhanced recovery protocols.
subtopics.short_description: Minimally invasive and open management of colorectal cancer, IBD, hernia, and enhanced recovery protocols.

subtopics.label: Transcatheter and Structural Heart Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR), transcatheter mitral and tricuspid interventions, left atrial appendage occlusion, catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation, and outcomes of percutaneous structural heart procedures.
subtopics.short_description: TAVR, transcatheter mitral and tricuspid repair, and outcomes of percutaneous structural heart procedures.

subtopics.label: Head and Neck Surgery and Thyroid/Parathyroid Procedures
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of thyroid and parathyroid diseases, head and neck cancers, salivary gland tumors, laryngeal procedures, and outcomes of head and neck surgical interventions including voice and swallowing outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Head & Neck Surgery with Thyroid Procedures
subtopics.short_description: Surgical management of thyroid, parathyroid, head and neck cancers, and salivary gland tumors.

subtopics.label: Urologic Surgery and Prostate Cancer Treatment
subtopics.description: Research on surgical management of prostate cancer (radical prostatectomy, focal ablation), bladder cancer, upper tract urothelial carcinoma, kidney tumors, and urologic procedures including outcomes of robotic-assisted approaches and biopsy techniques.
subtopics.short_description: Robotic and open surgical management of prostate, bladder, and kidney cancers with functional outcome analysis.

subtopics.label: Obstetric and Gynecologic Surgery
subtopics.description: Research on cesarean delivery, perioperative management in obstetrics, gynecologic laparoscopy, hysterectomy, fibroid management, pelvic organ prolapse repair, sterilization procedures, and outcomes in obstetric and gynecologic surgical care.
subtopics.short_description: Cesarean delivery, laparoscopic gynecology, hysterectomy, and pelvic organ prolapse repair outcomes.

subtopics.label: Global Surgery, Surgical Education, and Workforce
subtopics.description: Research on surgical training, education, simulation, global surgery in low- and middle-income countries, surgical workforce diversity, and quality improvement in surgical care delivery including disparities in access and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical training, simulation, global access in low-income settings, and workforce diversity and quality improvement.

subtopics.label: Perioperative Management and Anesthesia
subtopics.description: Research on perioperative risk stratification, anesthetic techniques, enhanced recovery after surgery (ERAS) protocols, intraoperative monitoring, transfusion practices, and postoperative complications management across surgical specialties.
subtopics.short_description: Risk stratification, anesthetic techniques, ERAS protocols, and postoperative complication management across surgical specialties.

subtopics.label: Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting and Revascularization Strategies
subtopics.description: Research on CABG techniques, graft selection (arterial vs. venous), outcomes by sex and age, multivessel disease management, and comparisons between surgical and percutaneous coronary revascularization approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Graft selection, multivessel disease management, and surgical versus percutaneous revascularization comparisons.

subtopics.label: Heart Transplantation and Mechanical Circulatory Support
subtopics.description: Studies examining outcomes after heart transplantation (including donor factors, recipient characteristics, allograft vasculopathy, and rejection), as well as left ventricular assist devices, VA-ECMO, and mechanical circulatory support in cardiogenic shock.
subtopics.short_description: Outcomes after heart transplantation, left ventricular assist devices, and VA-ECMO in cardiogenic shock.

subtopics.label: Cardiac Valve Surgery and Aortic Root Procedures
subtopics.description: Research on surgical aortic valve replacement, mitral valve repair, aortic root replacement, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy myectomy, and outcomes related to valve type selection, frailty, and concomitant procedures.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical aortic and mitral valve repair, aortic root replacement, and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy myectomy outcomes.

subtopics.label: Aortic Arch Surgery and Acute Aortic Dissection
subtopics.description: Studies on open aortic arch repair, management of acute type A aortic dissection including malperfusion, elective proximal aortic surgery in high-risk patients, and outcomes in thoracoabdominal aortic aneurysm repair.
subtopics.short_description: Open arch repair, acute type A aortic dissection management, and thoracoabdominal aneurysm repair outcomes.

subtopics.label: Peripheral Nerve Decompression Surgery for Headache and Neuralgia
subtopics.description: Research on surgical decompression of occipital, trigeminal, and other peripheral nerves for treatment of chronic headache disorders, occipital neuralgia, and nerve compression syndromes, including outcomes, treatment delays, and reoperation rates.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical decompression of occipital and trigeminal nerves for chronic headache, neuralgia, and nerve compression syndromes.

subtopics.label: Breast Implant Design, Safety, and Tissue Engineering
subtopics.description: Studies on breast implant surface properties (smooth vs. textured), antifibrotic coatings, positional stability, biocompatibility, capsule formation, and novel tissue engineering approaches including decellularized scaffolds and nipple reconstruction.
subtopics.short_description: Implant surface properties, antifibrotic coatings, biocompatibility, and decellularized scaffold approaches in breast reconstruction.

subtopics.label: Minimally Invasive Surgery for Pancreatic and Hepatobiliary Disease
subtopics.description: Research on minimally invasive pancreatectomy, liver resection, robotic and laparoscopic approaches for pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, hepatocellular carcinoma, cholangiocarcinoma, and related hepatobiliary conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Robotic and laparoscopic pancreatectomy and liver resection for pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors and hepatobiliary malignancies.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Otolaryngology and Aerodigestive Procedures
subtopics.description: Studies on pediatric ear, nose, and throat conditions including tympanostomy tubes, ankyloglossia, obstructive sleep apnea, aerodigestive evaluation for aspiration and recurrent croup, and tracheostomy timing in critically ill children.
subtopics.short_description: Pediatric ENT conditions including tympanostomy, ankyloglossia, sleep apnea, and tracheostomy in critically ill children.

subtopics.label: Craniofacial Surgery and Facial Fracture Management
subtopics.description: Research on management of facial fractures (frontal sinus, zygoma, mandible, orbital), craniofacial syndrome multidisciplinary care, orofacial clefts, and reconstructive outcomes in craniofacial conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Repair of frontal sinus, orbital, and mandibular fractures, orofacial clefts, and craniofacial syndrome reconstruction.

subtopics.label: Deep Brain Stimulation and Neuromodulation for Movement and Brain Disorders
subtopics.description: Studies on deep brain stimulation for Parkinson's disease, traumatic brain injury, and other neurological conditions, including programming practices, patient perspectives, MR-guided focused ultrasound, and intrathecal baclofen therapy.
subtopics.short_description: DBS for Parkinson's disease and neurological disorders, MR-guided focused ultrasound, and intrathecal baclofen therapy.

subtopics.label: Intracerebral Hemorrhage and Stroke Surgical Management
subtopics.description: Research on surgical and minimally invasive management of intracerebral hemorrhage, intraventricular hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage, and ischemic stroke interventions including catheter-based thrombectomy and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical and minimally invasive management of intracerebral hemorrhage, subarachnoid hemorrhage, and ischemic stroke.

subtopics.label: Male Reproductive Surgery and Fertility Procedures
subtopics.description: Studies on vasectomy reversal, varicocelectomy, ejaculatory duct obstruction, testicular torsion, and their effects on semen parameters, sperm function, and reproductive outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Vasectomy reversal, varicocelectomy, and ejaculatory duct procedures and their effects on reproductive outcomes.

subtopics.label: Surgical Oncology of Adrenal, Endocrine, and Rare Tumors
subtopics.description: Research on adrenalectomy for primary hyperaldosteronism and adrenocortical carcinoma, splenectomy pathology, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, and genomic predictors of recurrence after resection of endocrine malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: Adrenalectomy, pancreatic neuroendocrine tumor resection, and genomic predictors of recurrence in endocrine malignancies.

subtopics.label: Orthopedic Joint Reconstruction and Arthroplasty Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies on total hip and knee arthroplasty outcomes including revision rates, sex differences, safety-net hospital burden, peer coaching interventions, ankle replacement versus arthrodesis, and distal fibula fracture fixation.
subtopics.short_description: Total hip and knee arthroplasty outcomes including revision rates, sex differences, and ankle replacement comparisons.

subtopics.label: Ophthalmic Surgery Outcomes and Device Safety
subtopics.description: Research on cataract surgery techniques and complications, glaucoma surgery device adverse events, vitrectomy platform safety, intraocular lens fixation, ocular gene therapy delivery, and ophthalmic surgical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Cataract and glaucoma surgery outcomes, intraocular lens fixation, vitrectomy safety, and ocular gene therapy delivery.
